description_en: Deletes an internal mount target of an Apsara File Storage NAS file system created by Cloud Backup
description_zh: 删除一个由云备份服务创建的阿里云文件存储NAS内部挂载点
name: DetachNasFileSystem

parameters.help_en: The ID of the file system
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.help_en: The time when the file system was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 文件系统创建时间。UNIX时间，单位为秒
parameters.name: create_time

parameters.help_en:
The cross-account backup type. Valid values: 
SELF_ACCOUNT: current account backup. 
CROSS_ACCOUNT: cross-account backup
parameters.help_zh:
跨账号备份类型。支持： 
SELF_ACCOUNT：本账号备份 
CROSS_ACCOUNT：跨账号备份
parameters.name: cross_account_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source account for cross-account backup managed by the current account
parameters.help_zh: 被当前账号管理的跨账号备份的原账号ID
parameters.name: cross_account_user_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the RAM role created in the source account for cross-account backup managed by the current account
parameters.help_zh: 被当前账号管理的跨账号备份的原账号RAM中创建的角色名
parameters.name: cross_account_role_name

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates success

Message.description_en: The returned message. successful indicates success. If an error occurs, the corresponding error message is returned
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true表示成功。
false表示失败

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the asynchronous task. You can call the DescribeTask operation to obtain the task result
TaskId.description_zh: 异步任务ID。可以通过调用DescribeTask获取任务结果
